Subject: Request: IR plan + forensics snapshot for upcoming audit

Hi Olga,

We're entering the vendor security audit window for Ava Health and CorpAudit is asking for our incident response plan and a short forensics snapshot covering a suspicious auth anomaly they flagged on May 8. They requested: IR plan (current), a concise forensics summary of the event window (UTC 2027-05-08 03:00 - 2027-05-09 06:00), and an index of related artifacts.

Can Redwood provide the IRP and any available logs/forensics we can share with the auditor by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-11)? If you need a formal SIG/CAIQ scope, let me know — the audit team will accept either a SIG evidence bundle or a targeted IR packet.

Thanks,
Sam Rios
Information Security Manager
Ava Health

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: IR packet and forensics summary delivered (Ava Health)

All — packet delivered to the secure drive and attached here as quick stubs. Summary of what was delivered:

1) For Ava Health audit (requested window UTC 2027-05-08 03:00 - 2027-05-09 06:00) we uploaded:
   - redwood_irp_v2.1.pdf (full IR plan)
   - forensics_summary_avahealth_20270509.pdf (2-page executive summary of findings)
   - access_logs_20270508-20270509.csv (session-id, timestamp, source_ip, action) — usernames obfuscated
   - evidence_index_avahealth_20270511.csv (index mapping file IDs, collection hashes, and brief descriptions)

2) Key findings (brief):
   - Detected a series of failed login attempts followed by a two-minute window of successful token refreshes from a limited IP set.
   - No evidence of data export or system-wide exfil; token refreshes appear limited to a handful of service accounts.
   - Root cause likely misconfigured automated credentials rotation on a partner microservice; mitigation: forced token revocation and rotation policy enforcement applied at 10:40 UTC 2027-05-09.

3) Actions taken:
   - Revoked affected tokens and rotated keys for implicated service accounts.
   - Added short-term elevated logging and retention for the affected subsystem (30 days).
   - Platform patch scheduled for 2027-05-18 to harden credential refresh flow.

4) Next steps requested of Ava Health / CorpAudit:
   - Confirm receipt of the drive folder and that the CSV format is acceptable.
   - If CorpAudit requires a SIG crosswalk, tell us which control families they want prioritized and we will expand the bundle.

Links and artifacts:
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-ava-evidence
- Internal forensics page: https://redwood-internal.example.com/forensics/AVA-20270509

I'll mark this as resolved on our side pending any follow-up questions from CorpAudit. If Evelyn or Karthik want to update the mitigation timeline in the record, please reply-all with entries to append to the evidence index.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
